verdict.rationale: Yapily is an open banking data and payments API, so in-product AI insights are a fair axis for it. The only related evidence is transaction categorisation with "spending insights" (yapily-docs-3), which is never described as AI-generated, so it is an adjacent analytics feature rather than the capability itself. The MCP and llms.txt items only connect coding agents to the documentation, not to the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Categorise and analyse transaction data with merchant detection and spending insights.
